records.before_paragraph: Relapse is explicit for Ewing sarcoma; the national osteosarcoma indication does not add a relapse qualifier. The source gives no numeric age cutoff. Etoposide use for this indication is unlicensed in Ireland and requires the documented local discussion and governance process.
records.after_paragraph: This treatment is used for Ewing sarcoma that has returned and for osteosarcoma, whether or not it has returned. National guidance gives no numerical age limit. Etoposide use for these diagnoses is unlicensed in Ireland; your team must explain this, document your consent and follow the hospital’s medicines policies.

records.before_paragraph: The maximum is four cycles. The detailed national eligibility paragraph describes Ewing sarcoma; its timing definitions must not be copied automatically into the separately listed relapsed osteosarcoma indication. No numeric age or performance-status cutoff is invented.
records.after_paragraph: Treatment is limited to a maximum of four cycles. Your specialist will confirm the eligibility and timing requirements for your diagnosis: the Ewing sarcoma criteria do not automatically apply to relapsed osteosarcoma. The national guidance does not specify a numerical age or fitness-score limit.
